description.value: Hundo-P is a Whistler-born smoothie and non-dairy ice cream shop that opened in Whistler Village in 2019, built around real-fruit superfood smoothies and coconut-cashew ice cream made fresh in front of customers. The menu emphasizes whole, clean ingredients — organic nuts, dates, fruit, and protein — making it a natural refuelling stop after a big day on the bike. The shop also stocks packaged protein bars, baked goods, and snacks for riders on the go.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (16 spaces) at 44m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Hundo-P is an active smoothie and non-dairy ice cream shop with two locations; the Whistler store at 4211 Sunshine Pl matches the OSM address. The OSM tag shop=health_food led to a Groceries categorization, but the website reveals this is primarily a quick-service smoothie/ice cream bar with packaged snacks — not a grocery store. No website evidence exists for bike parking, water refill, or most amenities.
concerns: OSM category shop=health_food does not accurately reflect the business; it is a smoothie and ice cream bar, not a health-food grocery store.
OSM opening hours (Mo-Su 09:00-17:00) appear to differ from the hours listed on the website for the Whistler location, suggesting the OSM record may be outdated.
No phone number found in OSM tags or on the website; only an email address (info@hundop.ca) is listed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible business in Whistler Village offering smoothies, ice cream, and packaged snacks — a natural refuelling stop for touring cyclists.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags as shop=health_food, but the business is a smoothie and non-dairy ice cream shop with packaged snacks — not a grocery retailer. More accurately categorized as a café or snack bar.
